icons.name: airplane
icons.heading: Airplane
icons.description: The plane takes off. Light: it turns its nose 35° toward the upper right and accelerates out along it, laying a contrail from each wingtip and the tail, and fades before the edge; the contrails hang until it returns; it glides back in from the lower left on the same line, levels off and lands on its rest pose with a small overshoot. Strong: a short draw-back first, a faster launch with contrails twice as long, and a landing that overshoots and settles in two beats.

icons.name: passport
icons.heading: Passport
icons.description: The passport is stamped at the border. Light: the globe emblem swells as the stamp comes up to it, then slams back to size with a hit; impact ticks flash out on both sides of the cover and the booklet dips under the blow and springs back. Strong: a light tap first, then the full stamp: the emblem swells further and slams harder, the ticks fly out further, the booklet dips deeper and settles in two beats. The booklet stays rigid.

Strong: the beam sweeps across and back, a double read, and the pass hops higher and lands with two decaying bounces. The pass stays rigid with all its print.

icons.name: backpack
icons.heading: Backpack
icons.description: The pack is zipped shut, ready to go. Light: the zip across the flap runs open to the left, then closes back across to the right with a hit, and the pull tugs the pack after it, leaning left then right; the zipped pack hops once and lands with a small bounce. Strong: the zip opens, pauses, and snaps shut harder; the pack hops higher and lands with two decaying bounces while the fabric grab loop lags: it stretches at the top of the hop, squashes on landing and springs back. The pack stays one rigid piece.

icons.name: bicycle
icons.heading: Bicycle
icons.description: A pedal stroke sends the bike off. Light: the crank turns half a revolution; the push lifts the front wheel and the bike surges forward while two speed lines stream out behind it; the front wheel lands with a hit, the rear answers with a small rebound, and the bike eases back onto its spot as the lines fade. Strong: the rider loads the pedal first and the bike rocks back, then the crank turns a full revolution, the front lifts into a small wheelie, the surge goes further with longer streaks, and the landing bounces twice. The bike stays rigid; only the crank turns.

icons.name: signpost
icons.heading: Signpost
icons.description: The signpost points the ways.
